name: pro-core
description: Universal base skills and guardrails: find-skills, using-pro-dev (the cross-lifecycle router that maps a task to the right phase and skill, including bridge skills like impeccable-bridge, qa-suite, and lavish), and dream (memory consolidation over Claude Code auto-memory: scans session transcripts for corrections, decisions, preferences, and patterns, merges the findings into the memory files, and rebuilds a lean MEMORY.md index under 200 lines). /gh universal GitHub workflow command (briefing, new, commit, push, pr, ship, sync, resolve). /dream runs a consolidation on demand, with dry-run and status modes. /kaizen raises the bar one notch per run from a planning repo: it judges each tracked project against its own profile and current practice, red-teams it, applies one reversible improvement, briefs the rest and writes a dated ledger and HTML report; /kaizen init scaffolds the planning repo. PreToolUse hook blocks dangerous Bash (force-push to main, rm -rf /, .env redirects, sudo, chmod 777, curl|bash). SessionStart hook nudges parallel subagent dispatch. A Stop hook flags when a 24h memory consolidation is due, per project, and a SessionStart hook nudges the next session to run /dream. A UserPromptSubmit hook recalls the memories relevant to each prompt, ranking the project's memory notes with BM25 and injecting nothing when nothing clears the score floor. A second Stop hook keeps a dated session ledger under the memory directory so consolidation knows which transcripts to read. /pro-dev install|update|check sets up and refreshes the bridge engines from one registry, updates the pro-dev plugins in every scope that covers the repo and health-checks the install; a SessionStart hook nudges /pro-dev update when the registry changed.
